name: When is the best time to schedule kitchen cabinet removal?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to schedule kitchen cabinet removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to schedule kitchen cabinet removal is typically right before your new cabinets are ready for installation, or as the initial phase of a broader kitchen renovation project. Coordinating removal with subsequent installations minimizes the time your kitchen is non-functional. It also allows for any necessary repairs, painting, or flooring work to be completed in the empty space. We recommend planning ahead to align all project timelines efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule removal just before new cabinet installation or as the first step of a major renovation to minimize kitchen downtime and allow other work.
